1QR Pro — chhota icon + minimal

Quick bar me QR · side panel QR code (icon · minimal) · ☰ Menu → File → QR Pro (icon + minimal).

Centre icon

  • 10 built-in icons — Shop, Cart, Phone, WhatsApp, Instagram, ₹, %, Star, Heart.
  • Apna logo upload (PNG/JPG) — icon white tile par baithta hai, QR ke saath clean.
  • Icon size slider 8–30% + icon safety meter: "icon 18% (7 modules) — 11/56 recoverable — Safe ✓".
  • Icon on = EC H (30%) auto — logo ke peeche se bhi QR padha jata hai.

Minimal QR (kam modules = aasan scan)

  • Mode auto: digits → numeric, CAPS/symbols → alphanumeric, warna byte. 9876543210 = sirf 21×21 modules.
  • EC auto (minimal) ya manual L/M/Q/H · density meter (Bahut minimal → Dense) · min 4 px/module print rule.
  • Short-link buttons: https:// aur www. hatao → kam modules.
  • Quick chips: Website · WhatsApp · UPI pay · Phone · vCard · PNG 1200 px · vector SVG · Design me add · QR + Print Pack.
Verify kiya: URL, UPI, vCard, Hindi/emoji, numeric, alphanumeric — sab QR scan hote hain (jsQR decode). Aur L/M/Q/H chaaron levels ka module-matrix reference QR encoder se bilkul identical (16/16 cases).

5 layout styles (har ratio par)

Retail sale · Brand / name board · Offer / discount · Menu / rate board · Wayfinding / arrow — sab click.

Design theory jo app khud lagata hai

Safe marginShort side ka 6% — text kabhi edge par nahi (test-verified har ratio me).
3-zone gridBrand · message · contact + QR — wide me left/centre/right, square me top/middle/bottom.
HierarchyHeadline ≈ 36% short side, brand ≈ 24%, body ≈ 7% — har ratio par same optical weight.
Production mathsEffective dpi auto (53–320), pixels 5200 px capped, viewing distance + min text height live.
